hud.bandwidthoptimizer.title: Bandwidth Optimizer
command.bandwidthoptimizer.help:
BandwidthOptimizer commands:
/bandwidthoptimizer hud - Toggle the local statistics HUD
/bandwidthoptimizer stats - Upload bandwidth statistics and create a web report
/bandwidthoptimizer debug - OP debugging and diagnostic tools
command.bandwidthoptimizer.network.unava: Network test unavailable: unsupported peer or closed connection.
command.bandwidthoptimizer.network.notic: Network testing adds traffic to this game connection and may temporarily increase latency. Results: BO diagnostics/network/probes.jsonl.
command.bandwidthoptimizer.network.inval: Network test rejected: invalid traffic budget or sending rate.
command.bandwidthoptimizer.network.conne: Network test stopped: the connection is closed.
command.bandwidthoptimizer.network.alrea: A network test is already running on this connection.
command.bandwidthoptimizer.network.busy_: Network testing is busy or cooling down. Try again later.
command.bandwidthoptimizer.network.write: Network test failed: socket write failed.
command.bandwidthoptimizer.network.local: Network test stopped: local network processing stalled.
command.bandwidthoptimizer.network.timeo: Network test timed out; this alone does not prove packet loss.
command.bandwidthoptimizer.network.faile: Network test failed. See the diagnostic report for details.
bo.network.title: Network analysis
bo.network.finished: Network test ended. Click to view results.
bo.network.retransmission_observed: TCP retransmissions observed at this endpoint; an exact packet loss rate cannot be calculated from this count.
bo.network.no_findings: No supported symptom threshold was reached; this does not prove network health.
bo.network.scope: Opt-in test: at most 2 MB each way, 8 Mbit/s; uses the current game route. TCP observations cover only each endpoint’s local TCP segment. Results describe this test window.
bo.network.progress: Sent %s MB; received %s MB; limit %s MB per direction
bo.network.finding.receive_rate_below_co: Measured receiving rate was below the configured sending limit.
bo.network.evidence.rtt: Idle p95 %s ms → loaded p95 %s ms
bo.network.state.stabilizing: Waiting for five seconds of world readiness.
bo.network.state.connection_changed: Connection changed; the test was stopped.
bo.network.state.unsupported: The server does not support this diagnostic version.
bo.network.state.world_not_ready: World readiness timed out; no test was started.
bo.network.state.busy_or_cooldown: Another client test is active or cooling down.
bo.network.state.already_running: A test is already active on this connection.
bo.network.state.failed: Test ended without completion. See the recorded observations.
bo.network.connection_reset: The local TCP connection was reset during this test.
bo.network.broken_pipe: A local socket write failed because the connection was closed.
bo.network.read_timeout: A read timeout was observed during this test.
bo.network.summary.retransmission: Possible packet loss; the packet-loss rate cannot be measured accurately in this test.
bo.network.summary.other: Another abnormal observation was recorded. See details.
bo.network.summary.upload_latency: Idle %s ms → upload load %s ms (increase %s ms)
bo.network.summary.upload_pause: Upload receive paused for %s ms, then resumed.
bo.network.summary.upload_rate: Measured upload receive rate %s KB/s; test send rate %s KB/s
bo.network.summary.download_latency: Idle %s ms → download load %s ms (increase %s ms)
bo.network.summary.download_pause: Download receive paused for %s ms, then resumed.
bo.network.summary.download_rate: Measured download receive rate %s KB/s; test send rate %s KB/s
bo.network.summary.transfer_latency: Idle %s ms → transfer load %s ms (increase %s ms)
bo.network.summary.transfer_pause: Data receive paused for %s ms, then resumed.
bo.network.summary.transfer_rate: Measured transfer receive rate %s KB/s; test send rate %s KB/s
bo.network.state.waiting_multiplayer: Join a multiplayer server to begin sampling automatically.
bo.network.chart.stages: Stage shading: idle blue / upload green / rest gray / download purple
bo.network.chart.thresholds.2: Red marks TCP retransmission windows; this is not a packet-loss count.
bo.network.chart.time: Elapsed since each endpoint started: 0–%s s
bo.network.chart.no_data: This metric was not sampled; it is not zero.
bo.network.chart.speed_legend: Upload: server receive; download: client receive
bo.network.server_failure: Server ended the probe: %s; stage: %s (%s s)
bo.network.partial_upload: Upload received by server: %s / %s KB (incomplete transfer; integrity not verified)
bo.network.partial_download: Download committed by server: %s / %s KB (does not mean the client received it completely)
bo.network.observed_latency: Server application round-trip latency p95 during %s: %s ms
